description: kith has tracing-subscriber for structured logs but no observability infrastructure. No OpenTelemetry, no Prometheus, no /metrics endpoint. Needs: Prometheus metrics on kithd (connection counts, messages delivered, peer federation latency, auth failures), OTLP export for traces/metrics/logs, and a /metrics scrape endpoint. Follow stoa's pattern: shared TelemetryConfig in kith-core, per-binary init, graceful no-op when OTLP endpoint is absent.
title: Add OpenTelemetry observability (metrics, traces, logs)
